theorem: Corollary 16.1(d) (p. 54 of v1), via Theorem C (Theorems 15.1-15.2, Corollaries 15.3-15.4) and Corollary 9.1(b)
model_check: Corollary 16.1(d): APSP on directed graphs with integer weights of absolute value at most n^nu and no negative cycles in n^(3-0.0055+o(1)) = n^(2.99450+o(1)) time, deterministically, on a word RAM with O(log N)-bit words (definition of H(epsilon, gamma)). Theorem C gives O(n^(3-epsilon*gamma+epsilon/(2r)) (log n)^(r+5)) for every fixed r, with H(1/14, 0.077) from Corollary 9.1(b), so every exponent above 2.9945 is proved, not 2.9945 itself. The fixed-width program and word-width quantifiers of EndStatement are an algorithmic interpretation, not a checked formal statement equivalence. Source comparison, not a proof check.
